description: This file declares the GStreamerMSEMediaPlayerClient class and related message classes, which implement a media player client interface for GStreamer-based media streaming with support for media source management, buffer pulling, playback state notifications, and QoS handling within a media streaming project.

classes.name: BufferPuller
classes.description: Handles pulling buffers from the media sink and manages buffer requests.

classes.name: HaveDataMessage
classes.description: Represents a message indicating media source has data available.

classes.name: PullBufferMessage
classes.description: Represents a message to pull buffer data from the sink.

classes.name: NeedDataMessage
classes.description: Represents a request for more media data.

classes.name: PlaybackStateMessage
classes.description: Represents a change in playback state.

classes.name: QosMessage
classes.description: Represents a QoS (Quality of Service) update message.

classes.name: SeekingState
classes.description: Enumeration for the seeking state of a media source.

classes.name: AttachedSource
classes.description: Associates a media source with its sink and manages its state.

classes.name: GStreamerMSEMediaPlayerClient
classes.description: Main class implementing the media player client interface for GStreamer with support for media source management, buffer pulling, and playback control.

methods.name: notifyDuration
methods.description: Notify the client of the media duration.

methods.name: notifyPosition
methods.description: Notify the client of the current playback position.

methods.name: notifyNativeSize
methods.description: Notify the client of the native video size.

methods.name: notifyNetworkState
methods.description: Notify the client of network state changes.

methods.name: notifyPlaybackState
methods.description: Notify the client of playback state changes.

methods.name: notifyVideoData
methods.description: Notify the client about availability of video data.

methods.name: notifyAudioData
methods.description: Notify the client about availability of audio data.

methods.name: notifyNeedMediaData
methods.description: Notify the client that more media data is needed.

methods.name: notifyCancelNeedMediaData
methods.description: Notify the client to cancel media data request.

methods.name: notifyQos
methods.description: Notify the client of QoS updates.

methods.name: notifyBufferUnderflow
methods.description: Notify the client of buffer underflow events.

methods.name: addSegment
methods.description: Add a media segment to the pipeline.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Seek to a specific position in media.

methods.name: attachSource
methods.description: Attach a media source to the player.

methods.name: removeSource
methods.description: Remove a media source from the player.

methods.name: requestPullBuffer
methods.description: Request to pull buffer data for a stream.

methods.name: notifySourceStartedSeeking
methods.description: Notify that a source has started seeking.

methods.name: startPullingDataIfSeekFinished
methods.description: Start pulling data if seeking has finished.

methods.name: renderFrame
methods.description: Render a frame from the sink.
